post_topic: Content multiplier agent shipped — closing a long-open gap in the marketing factory
image_description:
Single standalone diagram. One concept only. No panels, no grids, no collages. Full bleed 1080x1080px white background.

A left-to-right pipeline flow diagram titled 'Marketing Factory — Content Multiplier Agent' in bold at the top.

Far left: a single rectangular node labeled 'Product Research Layer' with a small database icon beneath it. A thick horizontal arrow points right from this node.

Center: a rectangular node slightly larger than the others, labeled 'Content Multiplier Agent' with a amber #F5A623 border and a small amber badge in the top-right corner reading 'NOW LIVE'. A subtle dashed outline behind it suggests where the phantom placeholder used to be, labeled in small gray text 'previously: phantom node'.

From the Content Multiplier Agent node, two arrows branch diagonally — one pointing to the upper-right to a node labeled 'Reddit Community Draft' with a small Reddit logo icon, and one pointing to the lower-right to a node labeled 'Facebook Community Draft' with a small Facebook logo icon.

Above the central arrow entering Content Multiplier Agent, a small amber callout label reads 'Same real research. No fabricated inputs.'

All other pipeline nodes not in focus are shown as smaller, faded gray boxes arranged in a vertical stack to the far left labeled 'Other Content Agents', connected by thin arrows also flowing from the Product Research Layer — indicating shared input source.

Navy #0A0F1E primary elements, blue #5a96ff highlights, amber #F5A623 callouts and important labels. Clean sans-serif font. Real cloud provider logos where relevant. Small text 'Kelvin Davis' bottom right corner. Professional LinkedIn infographic style similar to ByteByteGo. White background. No dark backgrounds.
